I went in about some skin changes on my arm, which I was reassured are normal. The GP offered to check my back while I was there and found something suspicious. Long story short, it was melanoma and was caught very early so hadn’t spread. Proactive doctor I cannot thank enough.*

Have been registered with the Practice for almost 20 years. My husband and I have never had a problem. Always been able to get an appointment when we needed one. During Covid we were offered telephone appointments, but always were invited in if the dr felt they needed to see us in person. Our children, now teens, were always seen quickly when they were little. Just now I  phoned at 8am, 2 minutes later I have an appointment for my eldest and he’s being seen this morning. They have dealt with my elderly mum as a ‘visitor’ in the past and she said she never felt so thoroughly examined before in her life (in a good way!) I have always been polite to the Receptionists and they in turn have always been kind and helpful to me.
A young colleague of mine has recently moved to the area and was reluctant to join given these reviews. I convinced her otherwise and she is so happy she did - she couldn’t believe how easy it is to get an appointment In comparison to her old Practice!
We don’t know how lucky we are.",null,[0,235]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6aUx1azJBRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x39f03e0a8916ae64!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICziLuk2AE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6aUx1azJBRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6aUx1azJBRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN6aUx1a09BEhNDZ3dJMWREZ3NnWVEyTF9FandFGi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ3ppTHVrdUFFEhNDZ3dJMWREZ3NnWVEyTF9FandFIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARZK4WiQo-8DkqE0Nnd0kxZERnc2dZUTJMX0Vqd0U&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiOqqbytrGTAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwiOqqbytrGTAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMVE0VEVrMVNWOWZSV2hDTkZwRk5uWnROSHBPTlRWNVFUQlJNRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpuVlVOYVVIZHphbXRuV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURLLVBieEdREAE",["0x0:0x39f03e0a8916ae64",null,1619720613527181,1755518901067052,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113242130188304287935/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Gina Lang","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJkdFXxWXYUXO94Hj1M0jkZaLPu-n7Fkx-OYHiVPmRY0JMD_g=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113242130188304287935?hl=en"],"113242130188304287935",null,9,0,null,[0,3,1],1,["9 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiOqqbytrGTAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"Edited 7 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["I don't understand the negative reviews, most surgeries run the same appointments wise .
